A carbuncle is a group of boils located in one area of the body. Carbuncles may have more than one head that fills with pus. Some people can get boils or carbuncles over and over in one spot of the body. People with certain illnesses like diabetes are more likely to get boils.

Furuncles on the face, in the nose or on the spine require medical attention. An additional complication is that furuncles can form clusters and develop into a carbuncle, a more serious condition. A carbuncle is a group of furuncles and involves deeper layers of the skin. Carbuncles are highly contagious and easily spread to other areas of the body and other people.
